shadows.name: seat-highlight
shadows.purpose: Hairline that seats a FramePanel in its tray.

shadows.name: resting-xs
shadows.purpose: Only ambient elevation on panels and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .df-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.841 0.238 128.85); color: oklch(0.405 0.101 131.063); height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.841 0.238 128.85); border-radius: 0.625rem; font-family: 'Oxanium Variable', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: inset 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 16%); transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .df-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.841 0.238 128.85 / 0.9); }

components.name: Frame Panel
components.description: Structural plate seated in a muted chassis tray.
components.css: .df-frame { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 1rem; background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375 / 0.72); padding: 4px; } .df-panel { position: relative; border-radius: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); background: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs, 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05)); }

narrative.overview: DrawFlow reads like calibrated instrumentation for construction lending: a light, near-neutral control plane where a single high-chroma chartreuse signal carries action and the geometric Oxanium typeface signals precision. Depth is tonal via the Frame-in-chassis system, not floating shadowed cards.
keyCharacteristics: Chartreuse primary as the single charged signal
Light theme chosen from the real scene

rules.name: The One Voltage Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse is the only high-chroma color; one charged element per view.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Never add a second typeface; contrast via weight and scale.

rules.name: The Chassis Rule
rules.body: Frame+FramePanel for structure, Card for content; never hand-roll wrapper cards or nest cards.

dos: Do keep chartreuse to the single forward action per view
Do let experienced builders skip first-run guidance without blocking the product
donts: Don't use side-stripe accent borders, gradient text, or decorative glassmorphism
Don't reach for a modal first; use inline/progressive disclosure
Don't patronize with forced tours or infantilizing celebration; no em dashes
